shots.title: Refresh session branch truth on heartbeat and status reads (#666)

hazards.description: The first live smoke test showed that an unscoped session in a linked checkout could only be resolved honestly after heartbeat recorded its worktree path.
[architect review] Routine transcript heartbeats bypassed linked-worktree checkout reconciliation
[architect review] Linked-checkout heartbeat reconciliation overwrote durable session role identity
[architect review] Dashboard and top-level swarm status presented stored branches as current
[security review] Cross-checkout heartbeats could preserve the wrong checkout and bypass collision protection
[security review] Branch observation executed Git in arbitrary persisted worktree paths

shots.notes: Added explicit current, at-start, and unknown branch provenance. Heartbeat now rejects cross-checkout updates, persists the caller checkout branch and linked path, and preserves durable role identity; session list, dashboard, swarm status, and MCP status share the same provenance without extending liveness on reads.

shots.title: Disambiguate concurrent session collision messages (#666)

hazards.description: [security review] A primary checkout stored as a worktree path bypassed collision protection
[security review] Prunable or missing Git worktree records still satisfied collision isolation

shots.notes: Collision output identifies sessions by durable session ID, IDE, and current checkout branch while omitting the misleading primary authority label. Isolation requires an existing, non-prunable, registered non-primary linked worktree; explicit primary, unrelated, deleted, and prunable paths are rejected or treated as unscoped.

shots.title: Show active actors and ticket claims in sprint status (#663)

hazards.description: [security review] Sprint-scoped active claims included expired and stale-session claims
[architect review] Heartbeat age created an unfenced reversible claim lease
[architect review] Ordinary commands implicitly pruned stale sessions and released their claims

shots.notes: Human and structured sprint status show active claim ownership plus explicit owner liveness. Claim authority persists until release, expiry, or an explicit session-prune transition; ordinary commands never delete stale-owned claims.

shots.title: Define strict help, option, and JSON behavior for sprint status (#664)

hazards.description: [security review] Workflow status JSON exposed raw persisted variables and definition fields

shots.notes: Status-specific help is read-only, unsupported options exit non-zero, and discriminated JSON remains structured across lifecycle, workflow, missing-state, and missing-execution responses. Workflow output uses an allowlisted projection that excludes variables, definitions, and session identity.

conditions.description: Session state is shared across primary and linked checkouts, while live branch identity must be re-observed from a registered checkout and must not mutate durable role semantics.

special_plays: Preserved heartbeat liveness semantics by observing branches on reads without writing heartbeat timestamps.
Verified the complete suite cannot mutate the live S262 sprint-state file.
Smoke-tested the compiled help, JSON, invalid-option, heartbeat, and session-list paths.

training.description: Stored identity fields need provenance when they can become stale; a current-looking historical value is worse than an explicitly qualified observation.
training.outcome: Branch status now says whether it is live, captured at start, or unknown.

nutrition.description: 259 test files passed; 4,304 tests passed and 27 were skipped.
TypeScript typecheck and the root plus pi-extension production build passed on Node 22.
The primary sprint-state SHA-256 remained unchanged across the full test suite.

bunker_locations: Reading branch state must not refresh session liveness.
A heartbeat must reject a caller checkout that contradicts the session's registered worktree.
The primary checkout must never satisfy worktree-isolation checks, even when persisted as a worktree path.
Prunable and missing Git worktree records must never satisfy worktree-isolation checks.
Stored worktree paths are data, not filesystem capabilities; observe them only after matching Git's registered worktree set.
Sprint JSON identity remains a string so decimal and canonical roadmap labels are not collapsed.
Public workflow status must project allowlisted fields instead of serializing persistence records.
yardage_book_updates: Use observeSessionBranches for presentation and the shared reconciliation helper for every heartbeat path.
Preserve durable role identity while refreshing checkout observations.
Filter active claims by explicit expiry in every store adapter.
Report owning-session freshness separately from claim authority; do not infer a reversible lease from heartbeat age.
Reserve destructive stale-session and claim cleanup for the explicit session-prune command.
Reject unknown status options before opening the store or reading sprint state.
Include active claims in both human and structured lifecycle status.
course_management_notes: Keep durable authenticated actor and authority semantics deferred to S264.
Carry the remaining post-merge retro state-path bypass into S263 lifecycle reconciliation.
